tasks.objective: Make the integration suite depend only on the built CLI and the documented test contracts, so that restructuring src/ cannot break it while behavior is unchanged.
completion_criteria: Searching test/integration/ for imports of src/ (any relative path reaching src/) finds none.
Agent-name, default-agent, and help exit-code expectations are literal values; temporarily editing a production constant they used to import cannot keep the corresponding test green.

For a first session and a retry, a test asserts that the recorded session prompt equals exactly the launch prompt, the separator, and dist/code.md with that session's nonce substituted. No integration test picks individual phrases out of the instructions.
Nonce masking works when the recorded prompts carry a nonce of a different length or alphabet; a small test-local check, or reasoning recorded in the notes, demonstrates this.

doc/TESTING.md lists AFK_TERMINATION_GRACE_MS, the shipped dist/code.md, the result-block example used by the fake agents, and Codex's --output-last-message as contracts the integration suite relies on.
pnpm check passes and git diff shows no change under src/.
constraints: Do not modify any file under src/.
Do not use Vitest snapshots (file or inline) for expected values.
Expected values come from the current code and build; documents under specs/_done/ are historical and must not be used as the source of expected behavior.

tasks.objective: Pin the complete [afk] stderr transcript of every existing shared harness scenario, for every agent, as literal expected output.
completion_criteria: Each shared scenario in agent-parity.test.ts asserts that stderr equals a literal expected transcript and that stdout is empty, for each agent. Scenarios: complete, task metadata, blocked, fail then complete, iteration limit, retry recovers, two consecutive execution errors, missing final response, protocol violation, timeout, interruption.

The transcripts include full execution-error detail text (including the protocol violation reason), stderr-tail lines, iteration and retry lines with numbers, the task-failure line, and the final status line, wherever the scenario produces them.
A launch-failure scenario runs for each agent and asserts exactly the execution-error prefix, the retry line, exit code 3, and two execution-error lines, without asserting the OS-specific error text.
Changing the wording, order, or count of any [afk] line in a local, uncommitted experiment makes at least one parity test fail; record the experiment in the notes and revert it.
pnpm check passes and git diff shows no change under src/.
constraints: Capture expected transcripts from the current build's actual output; do not compose them from the specification or from src/ string literals.
Do not modify any file under src/.
Do not use Vitest snapshots (file or inline) for expected values.

tasks.objective: Pin the retry-allowance reset, fail-is-not-an-error, last-iteration, and default-limit run-loop policies end to end for every agent.
completion_criteria: Per-agent scenarios exist for: execution error, repeat, execution error, complete (4 sessions, exit 0); and execution error, fail, execution error, complete (4 sessions, exit 0).
Per-agent scenarios exist for --max-iterations 1 with each of: execution error, repeat, fail, complete, blocked. Each asserts one session plus the exit code and final status given in AC-010.
A per-agent scenario without --max-iterations, with sessions that always repeat, asserts exactly 10 sessions, exit 4, and iteration lines 1/10 through 10/10.
Every new scenario asserts its full stderr transcript exactly, like the scenarios from TASK-002.
pnpm check passes and git diff shows no change under src/.
constraints: Do not modify any file under src/.
If current behavior differs from an expected outcome in the specification, do not change src/; report the finding with a fail outcome and a follow-up task.

tasks.objective: Pin how every kind of final response and agent exit is classified end to end for every agent, extending the shared fake agent where needed.
completion_criteria: Per-agent scenarios cover each invalid-response case listed in AC-012. Each asserts two sessions, exit 3, and the exact execution-error line with its reason text.

Per-agent scenarios show that a valid block carrying the session's nonce is acted on when surrounding text is present, and when a block with another nonce appears before it or after it. When two complete blocks carry the session's nonce, the last one wins.
Per-agent scenarios show that responses including task_id and task_plan_file are accepted (including blocked with both null), and that responses omitting both are accepted too.
A Codex scenario shows that a valid result block written only to stdout, with exit 0 and no output-file message, is reported as a missing final response.
The shared fake agent can end its own process with a chosen signal. A per-agent scenario asserts the signal execution-error line and the retry.
Each new fake-agent capability is documented in the fixture header and in the Step type in helpers.ts, and works for every agent's fake without a per-agent copy.
pnpm check passes and git diff shows no change under src/.
constraints: Do not modify any file under src/.
Extend fake-codex.mjs (shared by fake-claude.mjs); do not add per-agent fake copies.
Assert reason texts as the current build prints them.

tasks.objective: Pin timeout escalation, interruption by SIGINT, SIGTERM, or SIGHUP, and stderr-tail visibility end to end for every agent.
completion_criteria: A per-agent timeout scenario with an agent that ignores signals asserts that SIGINT then SIGTERM were received, that the agent pid is gone after afk exits, exit 5, and one session.
A per-agent scenario where the agent writes stderr and is then interrupted asserts that none of that stderr appears in afk's output.
Per-agent scenarios for non-zero exit, missing final response, and invalid final response, each after the agent wrote stderr, assert that the tail lines follow the execution-error line.
Per-agent scenarios that send SIGTERM and SIGHUP to afk assert the interrupted status line, exit 130, one session, and no running agent process afterwards.
pnpm check passes and git diff shows no change under src/.
constraints: Do not modify any file under src/.
Pass AFK_TERMINATION_GRACE_MS to keep termination scenarios fast.

tasks.objective: Pin prompt-source conflicts with stdin, Claude launch-argument limits, and the absence of harness-created files for every agent and stop reason.
completion_criteria: Tests show that a positional prompt or --prompt-file together with non-blank piped stdin runs with the explicit source as the launch prompt, and that the stdin data never appears in the session prompt.
A test shows that a positional prompt or --prompt-file with a stdin pipe that is never closed still launches its session and completes.
A Claude test shows that without --model or --reasoning-effort, the arguments contain neither --model nor --effort.
A Claude test shows that the arguments never contain a bypassPermissions permission mode, --dangerously-skip-permissions, --resume, --continue, or --fork-session, including on a retry.

For each agent and each stop reason (complete, blocked, execution error, iteration limit, timeout, interruption), a test shows that the workspace, home, and temporary directory are unchanged and that existing progress.txt and specs/ content is intact.
pnpm check passes and git diff shows no change under src/.
constraints: Do not modify any file under src/.

completion_criteria: The notes record, for every acceptance criterion, the integration test or tests that verify it.
